top_choice_rationale: P001 (Hyman, Brangwynne, Rosen) rewards a physical-chemical principle: multivalent molecules demix into liquid phases with a sharp, valency-dependent concentration threshold, and P-granule droplets show liquid behaviour in cells. These are thermodynamic results reproduced by many independent groups over more than fifteen years, and a citation worded around the principle and silent on which specific condensates are phase-separated in vivo avoids the contested claims. The Pappu and Mittag omission is a real cost of the three-name cap. P002 is second for its molecular definition and design logic, but the PROTAC and molecular-glue split and the lack of an approved PROTAC leave it less settled; nitrogenase is next as the most mature and reproduced work, followed by Pd C-N coupling, then base editing, with no award last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; some field overlap with B003 through lipid and protein self-assembly and phase behaviour, but no collaboration or institutional tie to the proposed laureates is apparent
